title: Comparative genomics of enrichment-culture MAGs from cattle manure–soil microcosms identifies convergent Sphingobacterium and Pseudomonas lineages with genomic potential for microbially induced carbonate precipitation
description: Analysis code, figure builders and supplementary tables for the comparative-genomic re-analysis of 111 publicly available metagenome-assembled genomes (Pérez-Valera and Elhottová 2025; NCBI BioProject PRJNA1231077; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15309541) recovered from enrichment cultures of dairy-cattle manure, manure-amended soil and soil microcosms. Six MAGs from two lineages (four Sphingobacterium, two Pseudomonas_E) are prioritized as candidates for microbially induced carbonate precipitation on the basis of urease and carbonic anhydrase gene content, UreC catalytic-residue conservation, purifying selection on urease genes and manure-associated adaptation traits. Corresponding author: Soon-Chan Kim.
